what: Fixed — Sentinel-2 ingestion above 30 min triggered an avoidable 403 per remaining band
title: nemeton 0.22.1 (2026-05-15)
text: stac_search_s2_pc() signs every COG href SAS token search time bakes scenes_df. long ingestion run, time loop reaches scene N token embedded hrefs expired (Planetary Computer SAS tokens last ~30 min). reactive recovery .terra_rast_with_pc_retry() (added v0.21.6) caught 403 individually: Every band every late scene paid one extra HTTP round-trip (~300 ms ) plus noisy s2:pc_token_refreshed event. typical 26-scene × 3-band run crossing 30 min mark, ’s ~50 wasted requests ~15 s latency. Fix: two new private helpers R/sentinel2.R: .pc_href_expires_at(href) — parses SAS se= query parameter, returns POSIXct (UTC) NA absent / unparseable. .pc_ensure_fresh_href(href, collection, grace_seconds = 60) — -op non-PC URLs hrefs whose se= comfortably future; otherwise calls .pc_resign_href() swap freshly-fetched token. Falls back original href token endpoint (reactive retry takes safety net). Wired .get_s2_band_raster() (R/monitoring.R) immediately FETCH href= trace, every band lookup gets last-second freshness check. Effect 45-minute run: zero s2:pc_token_refreshed events (except genuine clock-skew situations), warnings spread across worker console, measurable extra HTTP cost (proactive check one regex parse + one Sys.time() comparison, sub-microsecond). 6 new offline tests test-sentinel2.R covering: parser valid / missing / NA / NULL hrefs, -op non-PC unsigned URLs, -op token still fresh, resign within grace, fallback resign returns NULL.

what: Fixed — S2 band cache never populated because writeRaster couldn’t guess driver

GDAL creation options (TILED=YES, COMPRESS=DEFLATE, BLOCKXSIZE=256, BLOCKYSIZE=256, PREDICTOR=2) already GeoTIFF-specific, just makes driver selection explicit instead relying extension inference. what: Fixed — S2 cache leaves empty <cache_dir>/{scene_id}/ directories
title: nemeton 0.21.10 (2026-05-15)
text: ingest_sentinel2_timeseries(..., cache_dir = ...) created scene subdirectories <cache_dir>/ without B04.tif / B08.tif files inside. Root cause: terra::rast(href) VSI URL fetches COG header — pixel reads deferred something consumes SpatRaster (typically terra::writeRaster()). retry/auth-refresh helper .terra_rast_with_pc_retry() (v0.21.6 → v0.21.9) wrapped head request, : terra::rast(href) succeeds → metadata hand. terra::crop(r, ext) also lazy → still bytes downloaded. dir.create(<cache_dir>/{scene_id}/) succeeds → directory exists. terra::writeRaster(r, tmp, …) finally triggers byte-range reads COG VSI. SAS token expired mid-scene, Azure returned 5xx / 429 range request, step throws — past retry budget. tryCatch swallowed error cli::cli_warn(), unlinked partial .tmp, returned — leaving empty scene directory behind. fix moves AOI crop pixel materialization materialize closure passed .terra_rast_with_pc_retry(). steps now run inside retry/refresh loop: r_cropped + 0 canonical terra idiom “make SpatRaster -memory”: scalar arithmetic creates new SpatRaster whose values read RAM. VSI failure (auth expiry, transient 5xx, DNS hiccup mid-stream) surfaces inside loop triggers re-sign / exponential backoff just like metadata failure . downstream terra::writeRaster() writes RAM — VSI traffic — way can fail local disk /O. Defensive cleanup: terra::writeRaster() still fails genuinely local reason (disk full, permission denied, GDAL driver hiccup) dir.create(), now-empty scene_dir removed tryCatch diagnose_s2_cache() doesn’t keep flagging empty entry. Sibling-band files (previous successful B04 B08 fails) left untouched — partial caches preserved. Three new tests: .terra_rast_with_pc_retry: materialize closure runs success .terra_rast_with_pc_retry: materialize failure PC auth → token refresh + retry .terra_rast_with_pc_retry: materialize failure transient error → backoff retry .get_s2_band_raster: empty scene_dir removed writeRaster fails
code: materialize = function(r0) {   buf_native <- sf::st_transform(buf_plots, terra::crs(r0))   r_cropped  <- terra::crop(r0, terra::ext(terra::vect(buf_native)),                             snap = "out")   r_cropped + 0   # forces in-memory pixel read via terra arithmetic }

what: Fixed — transient DNS / network errors abort entire scenes
title: nemeton 0.21.9 (2026-05-13)
text: .terra_rast_with_pc_retry() used retry PC SAS 401/403. failure — including DNS hiccups (resolve host: …), connection timeouts, GDAL HTTP 5xx — propagated immediately, scene skipped, ingestion lost data usually 5-30 second blip. retry path now classifies error reacts accordingly: PC SAS auth (40[13], forbidden, unauthorized) PC blob URL → invalidate cached token, re-sign href, retry immediately. (Behaviour preserved v0.21.6.) Transient network (resolve host, connect, connection (timed |reset|refused), network unreachable, temporary failure, http error 5xx, gdal error … timeout) → sleep exponential backoff (2 s, 4 s, 8 s, …, capped 30 s) retry href. Anything else (404, malformed COG, permission denied) propagates immediately . Total budget 3 attempts per band default; override env var NEMETON_S2_MAX_TRIES (positive integer). new progress event s2:band_fetch_retry emitted sleep, payload scene_id, band, attempt, max_tries, retry_in_sec, error_message. Callers (nemetonshiny) can render toast like “Hoquet réseau sur scène X bande B04 — réessai dans 4 s” user sees pipeline recovering, stuck.

what: Added — auto-refresh of Planetary Computer SAS tokens on 403/401
title: nemeton 0.21.6 (2026-05-13)
text: previous design signed every href STAC search time relied terra::rast() reading later. PC SAS tokens last ~30 min, ingestion ran longer started hitting HTTP 403 last scenes’ bands. .get_s2_band_raster() now wraps terra::rast(href) .terra_rast_with_pc_retry(): First call goes -. failure, error message sniffed: href PC blob URL (*.blob.core.windows.net sig=… query) error matches \\b(40[13]|forbidden|unauthorized |authentication)\\b, cached SAS token sentinel-2-l2a invalidated, href re-signed fresh token, open retried exactly . Anything else (504, network, malformed COG, non-PC URL) propagates immediately — point spending token round-trip. Two new internal helpers back retry path: .pc_invalidate_token(collection) — drops one collection’s cached token next fetch hits /api/sas/v1/token/…. .pc_resign_href(href, collection) — strips current SAS query string applies freshly-fetched one (returns NULL token refresh failed). 10 new tests cover lazy creation, retry happy/sad paths, non-PC short-circuit, helper-level behaviours.

what: Fixed — transient STAC failures (HTTP 504/503/502) no longer abort the search
title: nemeton 0.21.5 (2026-05-13)
text: stac_search_s2() (CDSE / Planetary Computer implementations) now retry transient HTTP errors giving : Retried status codes: 429, 500, 502, 503, 504. default httr2 policy retries 429 + 503, left genuine Planetary Computer 504 Gateway Timeouts surfaced immediately toasts nemetonshiny. Default budget: 4 attempts per backend (≈ 14 s cumulative exponential backoff worst case: 2 + 4 + 8 s attempts, capped 60 s). Override via NEMETON_STAC_MAX_TRIES (integer env var). every configured backend exhausts retry budget, stac_search_s2() now emits single aggregated warning  — addition per-backend warnings — UI can render one toast instead stacking one per backend. retry policy also applied Planetary Computer SAS token fetch (/api/sas/v1/token/{collection}) legacy per-href sign endpoint (/api/sas/v1/sign), transient PC hiccup auth round-trip longer falls back unsigned URLs (Azure 409).

what: Added — on-disk COG band cache for ingest_sentinel2_timeseries()
title: nemeton 0.21.4 (2026-05-12)

Cache write failures warn, pipeline continues -memory raster. cache extent-aware: cached file whose bbox longer covers requested plots silently overwritten. new placette outside previous window therefore return stale data. complements skip_cached short-circuit added v0.21.3: Two new progress events: s2:band_cached — per band, payload scene_id, band, path. s2:band_fetched — per band, payload. title: nemeton 0.21.3 (2026-05-12)
text: ingest_sentinel2_timeseries() now accepts optional skip_cached = TRUE argument. STAC loop, queries obs_pixel identifies every obs_date already covered every plot zone × every requested band. Concretely turns re-run ingest_sentinel2_timeseries() already-populated zone ~1-2 GB network zero, preserving existing idempotent INSERT semantics. cache lookup partial-coverage-aware: requesting new band (e.g. adding "NBR" zone previously ingested "NDVI" ) trigger false-positive skip — scene re-extracted least one (plot, band) tuple still absent. Set skip_cached = FALSE force re-extraction unconditionally (debugging post-invalidation workflows). Two new progress phases emitted: s2:cache_lookup — STAC query, n_cached n_to_process UI can immediately show “x/y scenes already cache, fetching y” first HTTP read. s2:scene_cached — per skipped scene, mirroring s2:scene payload (scene_id, obs_date, cloud_pct, source). Lets toast tick cached scenes loop speed visual feedback. summary tibble gains n_scenes_cached column; s2:complete emits value alongside n_obs_inserted.

Callers — typically async worker nemetonshiny — can subscribe ordered, phase-level events surface live progress indicator user. callback receives single named list current discriminator. Phases emitted, order: fordead:start — , total (6 7 phases depending whether persistence requested), python_env, fordead_version. fordead:phase / fordead:phase_done — bracket phase phase_name, completed, total. seven possible phase_name values : "vegetation_index", "train_model", "forest_mask", "dieback_detection", "export_results", "postprocess", (con + zone_id supplied) "persist". fordead:complete — success, n_alerts_inserted duration_sec. fordead:error — failure, phase_name blew , error_message duration_sec. fordead:complete emitted case. Exceptions raised inside callback caught discarded — buggy UI never aborts FORDEAD pipeline. Default NULL preserves v0.21.1 behaviour (silent, events). call site needs change.

what: Fixed — DuckDB migration 0001 rejected by the parser
title: nemeton 0.21.1 (2026-05-12)
text: db_migrate() failed fresh DuckDB monitoring database Parser Error: syntax error near "GENERATED" — LINE 2: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED ALWAYS IDENTITY. DuckDB parser accept SQL-standard GENERATED ALWAYS IDENTITY clause, contrary comment shipped inst/db/migrations/duckdb/0001_init.sql. side effect, FK clauses also relied DELETE CASCADE, DuckDB rejects parse time. 0001_init.sql (DuckDB variant) now uses explicit CREATE SEQUENCE EXISTS … START 1 + INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('…') monitoring_zone, plot alert. DELETE CASCADE dropped three FK clauses (plot.zone_id, obs_pixel.plot_id, alert.plot_id). FK existence still enforced; current code path issues DELETE monitoring_zone / DELETE plot, documented restriction rather behavioural gap. Header comments updated reflect actual DuckDB-vs-PG differences (false claim IDENTITY support since 0.7). first launch nemetonshiny local DuckDB backend (NEMETON_DB_URL=duckdb:///... auto-detected *.duckdb path) now completes schema bootstrap cleanly.

Selection URL scheme. db_connect() inspects connection URL dispatches right driver : postgresql://user:pass@host:port/dbname → [RPostgres::Postgres()] (unchanged). duckdb:///absolute/path//file.duckdb → [duckdb::duckdb()]. parent directory created automatically. bare path ending .duckdb also accepted convenience. Two migration directories. inst/db/migrations/ now split pg/ (existing files — CREATE EXTENSION timescaledb, create_hypertable(), TIMESTAMPTZ…) duckdb/ (schema, minus TimescaleDB / PostGIS specifics — hypertable, GENERATED ALWAYS IDENTITY instead SERIAL, TIMESTAMP instead TIMESTAMPTZ). db_migrate() picks directory matching connection’s driver class. Portable SQL touches monitoring functions. list_alerts() longer uses PG-($n::text[]) cast. Filters now bind one parameter per value emit portable ($n, $n+1, …) clause works backends. .insert_obs_pixel() .insert_alerts() branch connection class emit CREATE TEMP TABLE … COMMIT DROP Postgres DROP TABLE EXISTS + CREATE TEMP TABLE + explicit DROP TABLE DuckDB (COMMIT DROP clause). Suggested dependency. duckdb (>= 0.8.0) added Suggests. PG path unaffected absence ; db_connect() loads duckdb URL scheme selects backend. Removed helper. .pg_text_array() dropped — existed support ($n::text[]) longer used. Internal, never exported.

what: Fixed — Planetary Computer SAS signing migrated to batch token endpoint
title: nemeton 0.20.1.9009 (development)
text: stac_search_s2_pc() used sign every Sentinel-2 band href individually /api/sas/v1/sign. single STAC search typically returns 20-50 scenes × 3 bands (B04, B08, B12), loop instantly hit Planetary Computer’s per-IP rate limit emitted 50+ PC sign failed: HTTP 429 Many Requests warnings, followed wave GDAL Error 1: HTTP error code : 409 sentinel2l2a01.blob.core.windows.net terra fell back unsigned URLs. signing now uses documented batch endpoint /api/sas/v1/token/{collection} instead. One HTTP call returns SAS query string valid whole collection ~30 minutes; cache per-process env (.pc_token_cache, keyed collection) append every href via new helper .pc_apply_token(). Subsequent searches R session reuse cached token 60 s msft:expiry. Net effect: search previously made 60-150 sign calls got rate-limited now makes single token call signs every href client-side. original .pc_sign_url() helper kept source documented single-href fallback longer called search path. New private helpers: .pc_collection_token(collection, grace_seconds = 60L) .pc_apply_token(href, token). New private cache env: .pc_token_cache (cleared session end). 6 new test_thats covering: token append bare href, leading-? normalisation, append existing query string, empty-token short-circuit, fresh-cache reuse, expired-cache refresh, network failure → NULL warning.

title: nemeton 0.20.1.9008 (development)
text: Planetary Computer SAS sign helper used fall back silently unsigned URL whenever httr2::req_perform() errored response body parsed. caused confusing wave HTTP 409 errors sentinel2l2a01.blob.core.windows.net (“file exist” via terra::rast()) whenever something — rate limit, timeout, transient auth — broke per-href signing loop. Two cli::cli_warn() calls now surface underlying cause can pick right durable fix (batched token endpoint, retry/backoff, …) instead guessing.

title: nemeton 0.20.0 (2026-04-25)
text: TimescaleDB-backed monitoring subsystem. First persisted time-series store nemeton, designed ingest Sentinel-2 observations demand detect drops vegetation indices. See specs/007-monitoring-continu/ full spec. Database layer (new R/db.R): db_connect(), db_disconnect(), db_migrate(). Connection URL via NEMETON_DB_URL. Migrations bundled inst/db/migrations/0001_init.sql create four tables — monitoring_zone, plot, obs_pixel, alert — obs_pixel promoted TimescaleDB hypertable chunked every 7 days. Tracking via schema_migration makes re-runs -ops. STAC Sentinel-2 client (new R/sentinel2.R): stac_search_s2() façade CDSE priority + Planetary Computer fallback (ADR-008 souveraineté UE). Per-backend helpers stac_search_s2_cdse() stac_search_s2_pc() exported finer control. PC hrefs signed via SAS-token endpoint terra::rast() reads work without authentication. -demand ingestion (new R/monitoring.R): register_monitoring_zone(con, name, polygon, placettes) upserts zone plots (idempotent (zone_id, plot_id)). ingest_sentinel2_timeseries(con, zone_id, start, end, bands = c("NDVI","NBR")) fetches matching scenes via STAC, computes NDVI B04/B08 NBR B08/B12 memory, extracts per-plot mean 15 m circular buffer exactextractr. Bulk INSERT obs_pixel via TEMP staging table + CONFLICT NOTHING. Alert detection (new R/alerts.R): detect_alerts(con, zone_id, threshold_ndvi_drop = 0.15, threshold_nbr_drop = 0.25, window_days = 30) uses SQL window function compare observation rolling mean preceding window; drops exceeding per-band threshold persisted alert (idempotent (plot_id, alert_type, trigger_date)) returned sf POINT object. Docker Compose (docker-compose.yml repo root, plus .env.example): single timescaledb service (timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg16) bound localhost, persistent volume nemeton_pg_data, healthcheck via pg_isready. Tests: test-db.R, test-sentinel2.R, test-alerts.R plus helper-monitoring.R. Unit tests cover URL parsing, STAC feature parsing, CDSE→PC fallback logic, bbox reprojection. Integration tests live TimescaleDB gated skip_if_no_timescaledb() (looks NEMETON_DB_URL_TEST).

what: New feature — Sample size from target error + CV typology (Épaississement 5.c)
title: nemeton 0.19.0 (2026-04-24)
text: R/sample_size.R — compute_sample_size(cv, target_error, alpha, N, max_iter, tol) implements classic Cochran formula n >= (t * CV / E)^2 iterative Student-t refinement degrees freedom optional finite-population correction n_corr = n / (1 + n/N). Returns sized n, converged t_used / df, convergence flag, iteration count, echoed inputs. Formulas standard sampling theory copyrightable; credit Max Bruciamacchie / AgroParisTech (PPtools, GPL-2, 2014) IFN-G/ha convention align . R/cv_typology.R — lookup tables helpers CV side equation: cv_typology() loads inst/extdata/cv_typology.csv: 8 generic forest contexts (5 peuplement-level, 3 stratification-level) low / mid / high CV bounds basal area G/ha. cv_lookup(context_key, position) reads single CV value. bdforet_v2_mapping() loads inst/extdata/bdforet_v2_mapping.csv: 32 BD Forêt v2 TFV codes mapped one generic contexts confidence flag (clear / ambiguous) secondary candidate ambiguous classes. cv_from_bdforet(bdforet_sf, position, aoi, tfv_col) returns area-weighted CV AOI, plus diagnostic summary (per-TFV share, ambiguous codes, unmapped codes). Polygons mapped NA (FF0 coupe rase, LA4 lande, etc.) excluded CV. R/sampling_plan.R — create_sampling_plan() now accepts target_error, cv, alpha over_ratio optional arguments. target_error + cv provided, n_base sized via compute_sample_size() n_over defaults ceiling(n_base * over_ratio) (default 20 %). previous n_base path preserved stays default neither argument set, least one must now provided. sizing result attached returned sf attr(plan, "sample_size"). CSV editability: typology files loaded via system.file() default, cv_typology(file = ...) bdforet_v2_mapping(file = ...) let user point custom CSV — useful tune bounds locally without rebuilding package. Tests: test-sample-size.R (24 assertions), test-cv-typology.R (24 assertions, including area-weighted aggregation ambiguous / unmapped paths), plus 7 new assertions test-sampling-plan.R target_error path. Full suite 5595 / 0 failure.

text: import_qfield_gpkg(path) reads placettes + arbres layers returned QField. validate_field_data(placettes, arbres, region, lang) checks referential integrity (orphan plot_id, duplicate tree_id), physical ranges (DBH (0, 300] cm, height [0, 80] m), species controlled domain region, returns {ok, errors, warnings} list. aggregate_plot_metrics(placettes, arbres, plot_radius) computes per-plot dendrometric aggregates — field_n_trees, field_dg_cm (quadratic mean diameter), field_h_dom_m (top 5 height), field_g_ha (basal area), field_cv_dbh / field_cv_h B2 structural component — sf can joined onto forest units. attach_field_data_to_units(units, field_agg) spatial-joins aggregates onto polygon units downstream indicators (P1 / P2 / B2 / C1 / R2) consume uniformly via field_* columns. R/ndp.R — detect_ndp() gains alternative QField path: field_plots_count >= 1 bumps NDP least 2 (Exploration); trees-per-plot average >= 10, level goes 3 (Diagnostic). tag_field_data_sources(data, placettes, arbres) helper sets expected attributes one call. inst/datasources/FR.json — new datasets.field_qfield entry declaring format (GeoPackage), required CRS (EPSG:2154), layers (placettes, arbres) NDP bump rule. Tests: test-sampling-plan.R (22 assertions across GRTS / LPM2 / random / constraint paths), test-qfield-import.R (26 assertions covering round-trip, validation failures, aggregates, units join), test-ndp-qfield.R (13 assertions alternative path including sources listing JSON declaration).

what: Calibration — F1 expert scores vs RMQS 1ère campagne (phase D)
title: nemeton 0.18.0
text: inst/scripts/calibrate_uts_rmqs.R — reproducible pipeline downloads RMQS 1ère campagne dataset (DOI 10.15454/QSXKGA, Etalab 2.0 licence, ≈ 2 171 sites, 2000-2009), joins topsoil CEC (0-30 cm, cec_40_1) site’s AFES 1995/2008 soil name (rp_95_nom / rp_2008_nom), classifies name one rpf_code values via keyword-priority dictionary, compares observed median CEC (mapped 0-100 via cec_to_fertility_score()) expert score. inst/extdata/uts_fertilite_rmqs_calibration.csv — calibration artefact: 45 rpf_code × 2 037 RMQS sites, one row per code n_sites, cec_median, cec_q25, cec_q75, observed_score, expert_score, delta boolean flag_outlier (|delta| > 20). Alluvial / colluvial soils -score CEC (FLU_TYP, COL_TYP, COL_CAL −40 −55): fertile deep, well-drained productive, hold many cations. SoilGrids path F1 -rate design. ORG_INS -scores CEC (+65): peat high CEC poor forestry (acidity, waterlogging). expert score rightly penalises CEC alone . BRUN_MES bucket biased (−49 378 sites): “plain BRUNISOL” RMQS labels fall via fallback, many sites show CEC compatible BRUN_DYS. scoring bug — mapping-granularity bug V2 classifier. Classes absent V1 expert table (30+ RMQS sites): PLANOSOL, PELOSOL, MAGNESISOL, FERSIALSOL, DOLOMITOSOL, ALUANDOSOL/ANDOSOL. Candidates V2 CSV extension. tests/testthat/test-uts-calibration-rmqs.R — integrity checks calibration CSV (schema, cross-reference expert table, arithmetic consistency, sample size, CEC quartile order). re-run pipeline.

what: New Features — F1 GIS Sol wiring (phase C)
title: nemeton 0.18.0
text: indicateur_f1_fertilite() gains third source option: source = "gissol" reads French RRP (Référentiel Régional Pédologique) polygon layer layers, intersects units, joins AFES 2008 typology code UTS crosswalk shipped inst/extdata/uts_fertilite_fr.csv, returns area-weighted fertility score per unit 0-100 scale. Units whose polygons carry codes absent table return NA; units outside RRP coverage return NA. cli::cli_warn summarises unknown codes present. rpf_code_col argument (default "rpf_code") lets caller point whatever column name source RRP uses AFES code (UTSDom, RPFdom, etc.) without pre-renaming columns. read_uts_fertility_table() — new exported helper returning V1 UTS → fertility crosswalk data.frame. Useful external review scoring ad-hoc joins arbitrary RRP vector data.

what: New Data — UTS → fertility lookup (F1 GIS Sol wiring, phase B)
title: nemeton 0.18.0
text: inst/extdata/uts_fertilite_fr.csv — V1 draft soil typology → forest-fertility crosswalk France, 54 rows covering 14 Grands Ensembles de Référence AFES 2008 Référentiel Pédologique (Brunisols, Luvisols, Podzosols, Alocrisols, Calcosols, Calcisols, Fluviosols, Colluviosols, Rankosols, Arenosols, Redoxisols, Reductisols, Peyrosols, Organosols, Régosols/Lithosols, Anthroposols). Columns: rpf_code, rpf_name, wrb_code (WRB 2014 equivalent), fertility_class (1–5), fertility_score (15/35/55/75/90 per agreed grid), texture_dom, drainage, depth_cm, ph_range, forest_note, source_biblio, notes. Sources: AFES 2008, Baize & Jabiol 1995, Duchaufour 2001, Jabiol et al. 2009, Bonneau 1995. Intended peer review pedologist production use. tests/testthat/test-uts-fertilite.R — integrity checks CSV (schema, unique keys, score grid, class distribution, coverage 14 AFES families).

what: New Features — F1 fertility from SoilGrids 2.0
title: nemeton 0.18.0
text: load_raster_source(source_key, country, aoi) — new exported loader resolves datasource key declared inst/datasources/<country>.json ready--use SpatRaster. Prepends /vsicurl/ raster_remote sources GDAL reads requested window (essential planet-scale feeds like SoilGrids). Crops optional AOI (reprojected raster’s native CRS). Refuses raster_local entries path (e.g. chm_opencanopy, materialised fly producing package). cec_to_fertility_score(cec_x10) — maps raw SoilGrids 2.0 Cation Exchange Capacity values (unit: cmol(c)/kg × 10) 0-100 fertility score, linearly [0, 30] cmol(c)/kg capped bounds. Thresholds follow Baize & Jabiol (1995). source = "layer" (default) — unchanged, reads user-supplied soil raster polygon layer min-max normalises per call. source = "soilgrids" — fetches SoilGrids 2.0 CEC topsoil raster via load_raster_source("soilgrids_cec"), extracts per-unit mean, maps 0-100 via cec_to_fertility_score(). inventory layer needed scores absolute (comparable across projects), unlike relative layer-mode score. Global coverage — works AOI. Behaviour fully backward-compatible source omitted.

title: nemeton 0.16.0
text: indicateur_c1_biomasse() gains chm = NULL argument. supplied dbh species columns, biomass derived IFN tarif  combined wood density (inst/extdata/wood_density.csv), biomass expansion factor (bef, default 1.30, IPCC 2006 temperate-forest default) carbon fraction. Stems per ha: prefer stems_col (default "stems_ha"), else derive density_col fraction × 500. Positively correlates age-based path varied stands (Spearman ρ ≥ 0.5). indicateur_b2_structure() gains chm = NULL cv_chm_weight = 0.2 arguments. CHM supplied, CV(height) per unit computed blended B2 score. Without strata/age inputs, CV(CHM) becomes primary structural-diversity proxy. Heterogeneous stands (tall + short pixels) score higher homogeneous ones. indicateur_r2_tempete() gains chm = NULL, species_field, h_dom_percentile h_reference arguments. base DEM/wind score modulated canopy-vulnerability factor  clamped [0.5, 1.5]: tall stands vulnerable short ones, equal height conifers (factor 1.2) score higher broadleaves (factor 0.8). three additions fully backward-compatible chm NULL. indicateur_p1_volume() gains chm = NULL argument. supplied, height fed IFN tarif  taken CHM (per-unit 90th-percentile via ) instead Näslund approximation . Typical RMSE reduction mature stands: 20 40 %. New optional arguments h_dom_percentile (default 0.9) pct_masked (emits warning greater 0.3, signalling heavily-masked CHM whose P1 estimate unreliable). Genus-level fallback now species-aware: conifers fall back CONIFER_GENUS, non-conifers BROADLEAF_GENUS. Previously every species defaulted broadleaf, penalised conifer volume estimates. Added PSME (Pseudotsuga menziesii, Douglas) POSP (Populus sp. cultivé) rows inst/extdata/ifn_volume_equations.csv longer fall back genus-level coefficients. New internal helper is_conifer() (shared compute_site_index()). Behaviour unchanged chm NULL: fully backward-compatible v0.15.x. New reference dataset inst/extdata/site_index_curves.csv covering 10 MVP species (QUPE, QURO, FASY, CASA, PIAB, ABAL, PSME, PISY, PIPI, POSP) plus two genus-level fallbacks (BROADLEAF_GENUS, CONIFER_GENUS). Generated published Chapman-Richards parametrizations Duplat & Tran-Ha 1997 related works, per-species source attribution. Distribution authorised M. Tran-Ha (personal communication, April 2026 — see inst/NOTICE). New compute_site_index(H_dom, age, species, reference_age = 50) performs bilinear interpolation five fertility classes returns dominant height reference age (metres). Vectorised; NA-safe; genus-level fallback species directly tabulated; case-insensitive species codes. New helpers list_site_index_species() read_site_index_curves(). New extract_h_dom(chm, units, percentile = 0.9) R/utils-chm.R: per-unit dominant height sanitised CHM raster (90th-percentile default). Falls back terra::extract() exactextractr absent. indicateur_p2_station() gains chm = NULL argument activates CHM mode supplied. CHM mode output column holds site index metres; legacy proxy (fertility × climate × species → m³/ha/yr) unchanged chm NULL. New vignette site-index-open-canopy_fr.Rmd — end--end workflow CHM P2 synthetic forest, section limits (CHM ML RMSE, sanitize_chm() importance, age dependency). detect_ndp() now returns ndp_result S3 object level, confidence, augmented, sources slots. augmented vector flags ML-derived layers height_ml attr(data, "chm_source") == "opencanopy". base NDP level global Fibonacci confidence unchanged. Breaking: detect_ndp() used return plain integer. Callers must now use result$level .integer(result). New accessor get_ndp_augmented(). New dataset entry chm_opencanopy inst/datasources/FR.json (type, format COG, required CRS, value range, provenance, license). New sanitize_chm() 5-step pipeline R/utils-chm.R (forest mask, buildings/water, NDVI threshold, plausibility bounds, slope coherence). Returns list(chm_clean, pct_masked, steps_applied) warns 50% valid pixels masked. New inst/NOTICE documenting third-party attributions (IGN BD ORTHO, Open-Canopy weights, LiDAR HD, OSO, WorldClim, Duplat & Tran-Ha site-index curves).
